newsitem.title: USA: Ball Corp sees Q4 near break-even.
newsitem.headline: Ball Corp sees Q4 near break-even.

text.p: Ball Corp said Friday it expects near break-even results in the fourth quarter, excluding a gain and charges.
Wall Street estimates are for the company to earn $0.37 per share for the fourth quarter and $1.50 for the year, according to First Call.
The company reported a loss of $300,000, or $0.01 per share, for the 1995 fourth quarter.
The company said it previously disclosed that its fourth quarter and full-year results would not be as strong as anticipated.

It said today expects a gain from selling its interest in Ball-Foster Glass Container Co LLC, and foresees charges from closing its Indiana metal food can plant and ending metal beverage can making at its plant in Quebec.
The company said it had named George Matsik, head of its international packaging operations, to the newly created position of chief operating officer.
"Matsik will focus immediate attention on improving Ball's operating performance," the company said.
